Definition: a departure from right, i.e. sin
BiblicalUsage: A set is a departure from right, a revolter, and Hosea names them: the revolters are profound to make slaughter, though I have been a rebuker of them all.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the revolters are profound in the worst way — deep in slaughter, while God stands as their rebuker.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
